explication: workerd is Cloudflare’s JavaScript/Wasm server runtime, used to host Workers, develop them locally, and proxy HTTP traffic. The principal flow is configuration defining Workers and sockets, the server binding listeners to services, and a Worker handling an incoming request to produce a response. The graph also preserves documented capability bindings and major runtime API families. The README and sampled server header support the entry-point relationships; unsampled subsystem links are shown only as dashed, unverified relationships.
